AI by the numbers: global market overview 2025

⏱ 6 min read📅 October 21, 2026✍️ custovox.ai

The global artificial intelligence market reached $572.96 billion in 2025, growing at +129.9% year over year. But behind this headline number lie very different dynamics across segments. Here is the data that actually matters for business teams.

A market that tripled in 5 years

Between 2020 and 2025, the global AI market grew by $354.42 billion. By 2032, it is expected to exceed $1.96 trillion — an additional $1.39 trillion growth over 7 years.

What stands out in these projections is less the absolute market size than its composition. Five segments are driving growth: Machine Learning, Computer Vision, AI Robotics, NLP, and Autonomous & Sensor Technology.

NLP: the fastest-growing segment in absolute terms

Natural Language Processing (NLP) shows the highest absolute growth of any AI segment between 2025 and 2032: +$742.68 billion expected, versus +$362.98 billion for Machine Learning and +$130.03 billion for Computer Vision.

Companies adopting NLP now are building a structural advantage over their competitors.

Generative AI dominates attention — and budgets

At $288.4 billion in 2025 with +238.5% growth, generative AI captures the most attention. The US dominates at $231.34 billion versus only $22.52 billion for Europe — a 10x gap that raises the question of AI sovereignty for European businesses.

61% of new global unicorns are AI startups

According to CB Insights, in 2025, 61% of newly minted unicorns worldwide are AI startups. Even more striking: 1 in 5 new unicorns in 2025 is an AI agent.

This figure illustrates the intensity of global investment in applied AI — not just fundamental research, but tools that transform how business works.

What this means for your business

AI is no longer a competitive advantage reserved for large tech companies. It has become an accessible tool — in terms of pricing, implementation time, and skills required.

NLP in particular is now available from $89/month with no data team, no complex configuration.

What this means for you

custovox.ai is one of the few NLP tools combining text, voice and visual analysis in a single platform, hosted in France, from $89/month.
